caseName: Whitmore ex rel. Simmons v. Arkansas
caseNameFull: Whitmore, Individually and as Next Friend of Simmons v. Arkansas

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ark. Motion of respondent Simmons for expedited review denied. Motion of respondent Simmons for oral argument denied. Motion of respondent Simmons to be present at oral argument denied. Motion of respondent Simmons to require petitioner to post bond denied.
